content.intro: This lesson introduces deploying python applications as part of professional python development and deployment. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Professional work is reproducible and observable. Separate configuration from code, test important failures, document setup, and verify the exact deployed runtime.
